transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I guess… my eating’s been pretty off lately. Some days I’ll just forget to eat, and then other nights I’m up after midnight going through takeout or snacks. It kind of freaked me out enough to come in.
When you eat after midnight, have you usually already been asleep first?
Not always. Sometimes I haven’t really slept yet… I just realize it’s after midnight and I’m eating takeout or whatever snacks are around. It’s been kind of all over the place.
When you eat late at night, do you feel unable to stop once you’ve started?

I don’t know if I’d say unable to stop exactly. It’s more like… my eating’s just been really off. Some days I miss meals completely, and then other nights I’m up after midnight going through takeout or snacks. That’s what kind of freaked me out.
When you eat late at night, are you fully awake?
Yeah, I’m awake. I mean… I haven’t always slept yet. I’ll just be up and realize it’s after midnight and I’m going through takeout or snacks. My eating’s just been all over the place.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Yeah… kind of. It’s been going on for a few months, I guess—maybe four. I’ve been feeling low and just not really caring much, and the guilt stuff got harder to ignore after what happened at work.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to do stuff on weekends—soccer, cooking for my girlfriend, checking out little galleries. Even helping the newer sales guys at work. Lately I just… can’t really make myself care about any of it.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite lately?
Yeah… it’s changed. Some days I just kind of forget to eat, and then other nights I’m up late going through takeout or snacks. It’s been pretty all over the place.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yeah… most nights. I either can’t really fall asleep because my head keeps running through work stuff, like pitches, or I wake up way too early and feel weirdly wired, even though I didn’t sleep much.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
Yeah… a bit. At work I’ll be putting in an order and then, like, a phone buzzes or someone walks by, and I’m just off it. I miss little details I normally wouldn’t.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
Yeah… I mean, I’ve had thoughts like… I wish I could just not wake up for a while. But I haven’t made any plan to hurt myself.
Have you been feeling slowed down, like your body or thoughts are moving noticeably more slowly than usual?

Kind of. It’s weird… at work I’ll be pacing around my car before appointments, tapping on the steering wheel and stuff. But then when I’m home, I can just sit on the couch and feel like getting up takes forever.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energized and needed much less sleep without feeling tired?
Yeah… some nights. I’ll barely sleep, but I’m still kind of wired. My mind just keeps running through work stuff, like pitches, and then I’m up way before my alarm.
During those times when you felt wired and slept very little, did you also feel unusually upbeat or unusually irritable?

Yeah… sometimes I wake up feeling like I’m just on top of everything, like I could outsell everybody. But then, if my manager or a client says one little thing, I get irritated way more than I should.
During those times when you felt wired and slept very little, were you doing a lot more than usual?
Yeah… I guess so. I’d end up doing way too much at once—rewriting sales decks, calling customers, planning new routes, trying to fix every account instead of just… slowing down.
During those wired times, did you feel more confident or important than usual?

Yeah… I mean, some mornings I feel like I can beat everybody, like outsell anyone in the region. It sounds stupid saying it, but I get really sure of myself. Then if my manager or a client makes some little comment, I can get set off pretty fast.
During those wired periods, do you find yourself talking more than usual?
Yeah… I guess I do. People at work have told me I’m talking too fast in meetings. And I notice I’ll jump in a lot, like if there’s a pause it feels like I’m… losing the room or something.
How long do those wired periods usually last?
It’s been… kind of this whole stretch, I guess. Since that fight with my regional manager, about a month ago.
During this wired stretch, has it caused serious problems at work or in your relationships?

Yeah… it’s caused some problems. My manager’s started taking me off certain accounts because I’m making dumb mistakes I usually don’t make. HR got involved after that employee-assistance call, too.

I’m still showing up and doing the job, mostly, but… work and home both feel like they’re kind of slipping away from me.
During that wired stretch, did you do anything unusually risky or impulsive for you?
I don’t know… not really, I guess. I mean, nothing huge comes to mind. Maybe I’ve been quicker to make decisions than usual, but I wouldn’t say I went and did something crazy.
During the past month, have you felt wired or unusually energized most of the day nearly every day?

Yeah… most days, I think. I had these days where I just couldn’t slow down — rewriting decks, calling customers, mapping out new routes, trying to fix every account at once. It felt like I had to keep moving.
